goal: Select and build an AI-powered ForgeHacks 2026 project with a working demo, honest evidence and a realistic shot at overall or track judging; do not claim winning odds
audience: Student hackathon judges and an actual narrow target user; one student builder in Iraq

competition.name: ForgeHacks Online 2026
judging: Real-world impact; must answer the track prompt
Technical implementation and meaningful AI use
submission: Description with target users, approach, impact

constraints.existing_code: Only a pre-event strategy document; substantial build must occur during the event

notes: The official AI+Cybersecurity prompt concerns recognition, prevention, verification or response to scams, impersonation and fraud enabled by AI/modern technologies. The older ActionProof refund-permission concept does not directly answer it. Critic should challenge any unsupported novelty or impact claim.
